comments.body:
This logic is duplicated.
Hardcoded magic numbers
```
  if (score >= 80) return "SUCCESS";
  if (score >= 40) return "WARNING";
```
Consider extracting these thresholds to named constants for maintainability:
`const SCORE_THRESHOLDS = { SUCCESS: 80, WARNING: 40 } as const;`

Repeated JSX for score text coloring `(threatscore-breakdown-card.tsx:82-88, 118-123, 140-145)`
The ternary chain for text colors appears 3 times:
```jsx
className={`... ${score >= 80 ? "text-success" : score >= 40 ? "text-warning" : "text-danger"}`}
```
Consider extracting to a helper function for DRYness.

Missing aria labels on collapsible
The collapsible button lacks explicit accessibility attributes:
`<CollapsibleTrigger className="text-default-500...">`
Suggestion: Add aria-expanded handling (though Radix handles this automatically, verify it's working).
